title: Preliminary Refinery Vessel Sizing Logic: Versions 1, 2 and 3
purpose: Convert validated process inputs into a traceable preliminary vessel type, orientation, internal diameter, tangent-to-tangent length or straight-side height, liquid levels, preliminary internals, governing case, warnings and engineering-review actions.

automation_model.interpretation: The 80 percent target applies after the process engineer supplies the minimum process basis. The engine automates calculations, case comparison, geometry iteration, recommendations, traceability and reporting. It does not invent missing process data or replace process, mechanical, safety, operations or vendor approval.
automated_by_engine: actual volumetric flow calculation where mass flow and density are available
retained_user_or_engineer_responsibiliti: define process service and separation objective
provide validated operating and upset cases
provide phase properties or validated simulator results
define retention, surge, slug and control-response requirements
identify foaming, fouling, solids and emulsion risks
approve company design libraries and configurable heuristics
approve final process design, mechanical design and safety basis
approve proprietary internals or vendor performance

included: flash-drum geometry using validated phase-equilibrium results
coalescer-assisted vessel shell screening using approved vendor library data
excluded: ASME shell and head thickness design
proprietary internals design without vendor data

reference_basis.title: Process Design of Oil and Gas Separators and Scrubbers
reference_basis.application: Reference architecture for pressure-vessel-based gas-liquid and gas-liquid-liquid separators, vertical scrubbers, knockout drums, horizontal free-water knockout vessels and conventional separation internals.
reference_basis.implementation_note: The licensed standard and owner engineering practices shall govern numerical criteria, allowable limits and final acceptance.

reference_basis.title: Pressure-Relieving and Depressurizing Systems
reference_basis.application: Required reference for flare and vent knockout-drum scenarios, liquid containment, relief and depressuring-system integration.
reference_basis.implementation_note: The app must use owner-approved API 521 criteria and credible relief/depressuring scenarios. It shall not create relief cases.

reference_basis.title: Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels, Division 1
reference_basis.application: Mechanical design, fabrication, inspection, testing and certification boundary.
reference_basis.implementation_note: Process sizing output is preliminary geometry only and must be transferred to a separate mechanical-design module.

mandatory_user_inputs.reason: normal, maximum, turndown, startup, upset or other credible cases
minimum removable droplet size, carryover target or approved service criterion
retention, control, surge, slug and emergency inventory basis
foaming, fouling, emulsion, solids, wax, coke, salt and corrosion risks

required_libraries.purpose: Approved gas-capacity factor or equivalent performance correlation by service, orientation, pressure, internals, droplet target, foaming and fouling condition.
Company-approved suggested retention, control and surge times by refinery service.
Approved mesh pad, vane pack, inlet device, coalescer and agglomerator capacities, pressure drops, fouling limits and removal performance.
Owner-approved minimum clearances, level bands, nozzle submergence, demister clearance and fabrication geometry rules.
Approved derating factors for foaming, fouling, high liquid loading, motion, uncertain properties and turndown.
Preferred diameter, length, head and plate-size increments used for candidate selection.

prohibited_default_behavior: do not hard-code one universal Souders-Brown K factor
do not invent liquid retention time
do not invent liquid-liquid droplet size
do not ignore foaming, fouling, emulsion or solids
do not substitute normal flow for missing maximum flow
do not select the first matching library record
do not select the highest-capacity library record automatically
do not use vendor internals performance without an approved record

gas_allowable_velocity_souders_brown.expression: V_allow_m_s = K_m_s * sqrt((rho_liquid_kg_m3 - rho_gas_kg_m3) / rho_gas_kg_m3) * combined_derating_factor
gas_allowable_velocity_souders_brown.valid_when: rho_liquid_kg_m3 > rho_gas_kg_m3 and K_m_s resolved from approved library

horizontal_circular_segment_area.expression: A_segment_m2 = R_m^2 * acos((R_m - h_m) / R_m) - (R_m - h_m) * sqrt(2 * R_m * h_m - h_m^2)

stokes_terminal_velocity.expression: V_terminal_m_s = g_m_s2 * droplet_diameter_m^2 * abs(rho_dispersed_kg_m3 - rho_continuous_kg_m3) / (18 * mu_continuous_Pa_s)
stokes_terminal_velocity.valid_when: droplet is approximately spherical and droplet Reynolds number is in approved Stokes range

schiller_naumann_drag_coefficient.valid_when: approved for preliminary spherical-droplet iteration and Re_droplet > stokes_limit

drag_based_terminal_velocity.expression: V_terminal_m_s = sqrt((4 * g_m_s2 * droplet_diameter_m * abs(rho_dispersed_kg_m3 - rho_continuous_kg_m3)) / (3 * Cd * rho_continuous_kg_m3))

actions: reject gauge pressure where absolute pressure is required
record source and timestamp for each input
compare direct and calculated flows where both are supplied
classify two-phase, three-phase, liquid-only or specialist service
route to applicable version and sizing module
stop affected calculations if fail-closed condition is triggered
retain at least the two best feasible options for comparison
solve required length or height for each candidate
calculate liquid-level bands and internal clearances
identify governing case for each constraint
rank compliant candidates by safety margin, plot impact, steel-volume proxy, controllability and maintainability
do not rank by minimum size alone
state governing case and governing constraint
publish assumptions, data sources, margins and warnings

vertical_rules.reason: gas-dominated service normally favors a compact vertical disengagement section
small liquid inventory reduces vertical shell-height penalty
vertical scrubber is a common preliminary configuration
solids handling and cleanout may constrain a conventional vertical configuration
large slug volume creates excessive vertical height

horizontal_rules.reason: horizontal geometry provides efficient liquid-volume distribution
horizontal vessel usually accommodates large slug volume more efficiently
horizontal orientation provides liquid-liquid interface area and control length
settling area and interface stability favor horizontal geometry
plot-length constraint makes horizontal arrangement infeasible

user_inputs_specific_to_version: gas and liquid flow for all credible cases
minimum droplet-removal target or approved gas-capacity library key
maximum credible slug volume where applicable

two_phase_common: calculate minimum, control, surge, slug and emergency liquid volumes
calculate inlet, disengagement and mist-eliminator zones
verify gas and liquid constraints for every case

height_logic: calculate bottom head and outlet clearance
calculate top disengagement and outlet clearance
round up to preferred straight-side increment
pass_criteria: available gas area at maximum liquid level >= required gas area
each liquid-level band provides required volume
all internals and nozzle clearances pass
overall slenderness is within owner-approved screening limits

for_each_diameter: calculate circular segment areas at LLL, NLL, HLL and HHLL
calculate gas area above HLL and HHLL
calculate shell length required for each liquid-volume band
calculate gas-capacity length or effective cross-sectional requirement
calculate inlet-to-outlet and internals clearance length

length_logic.expression: L_required_m = max(L_minimum_inventory_m, L_control_m, L_surge_m, L_slug_m, L_gas_capacity_m, L_internal_clearance_m)
length_logic.head_volume_policy: exclude head volume from guaranteed controllable liquid volume unless owner standard explicitly allows credit

pass_criteria: available gas area above governing liquid level >= required gas area

liquid_surge_drum.calculation: V_working_required_m3 = sum(applicable inventory components without double counting)
liquid_surge_drum.orientation_logic: compare vertical and horizontal geometry using inventory, pump submergence, plot area, control range and maintainability
mandatory_checks: no double counting between surge and response time

recommendation_confidence.high: all required inputs and approved library records are resolved; all margins >= configured target
recommendation_confidence.medium: minor non-governing assumptions remain or close orientation scores exist
recommendation_confidence.low: key service-risk or performance uncertainty exists; recommendation is screening only

user_inputs_specific_to_version: light- and heavy-liquid flow for all credible cases
design droplet size or approved performance library key
gas flow and properties where three phases are present
boot preference only as an optional override

calculation_sequence: identify continuous and dispersed phase for each separation direction
calculate Stokes terminal velocity as initial estimate
use Stokes result only within owner-approved Stokes range
calculate settling or rising distance available
calculate required separation area and residence volume
apply emulsion, uncertainty and flow-distribution derating
repeat for heavy droplets through light phase
repeat for light droplets through heavy phase

iterative_drag_solver.restriction: screening only; reject for non-spherical droplets, stable emulsions, non-Newtonian fluids or conditions outside approved correlation range

candidate_solver: select candidate oil and water interface levels
calculate gas area above high liquid level
calculate oil and water segment areas
calculate settling path and available interface area
calculate length required by each independent constraint
verify weir, boot or bucket arrangement

independent_constraints: heavy-droplet settling through light continuous phase
light-droplet rising through heavy continuous phase
liquid_liquid_decanter.selection_logic: select geometry satisfying both separation directions and both retention-volume checks

boot_acceptance: boot interface area passes settling requirement
boot volume passes retention and control requirements
no emulsion specialist trigger is active

automatic_recommendations: three-phase versus separate decanter configuration screening
commercial_and_operational_screen: compare one large three-phase vessel against two simpler vessels
flag emulsion risk that may make a smaller vessel false economy
show plot and steel-volume proxy for alternatives

user_inputs_specific_to_version: equipment protection target or relief/depressuring basis
all credible transient and maximum cases
allowable liquid carryover or droplet-removal target
maximum credible liquid slug or relief liquid load
validated flash calculation results where applicable
approved vendor coalescer performance data where applicable

automated_steps: select conservative governing gas and liquid case
select preliminary inlet and mist-removal arrangement
calculate liquid accumulation between alarms and trips
calculate demister drainage and liquid re-entrainment checks from approved library
orientation_logic: favor vertical for gas-dominated service with low liquid inventory
favor horizontal for large slug, high liquid loading or multiple liquid phases
calculate both when scores are close

automated_steps: evaluate each credible relief and depressuring scenario
calculate drain-down and residual inventory where applicable
flag low-temperature, two-phase, flashing and transient concerns
import vapor and liquid phase flows and properties
route to two-phase or three-phase separator engine
recommend internals based on flash severity and fouling
produce sensitivity to pressure and temperature cases
flash_drum_with_validated_simulator_inpu.thermodynamic_boundary: The geometry engine may consume validated phase-equilibrium results. It shall not use a simplified ideal flash for refinery mixtures as a default.

automated_steps: calculate element count or module count
calculate preliminary vessel diameter around element arrangement
calculate upstream distribution and downstream settling zones
calculate clean and fouled pressure-drop screen
compare gravity-only and coalescer-assisted vessel size

automatic_recommendations: need for separate upstream slug receiver
decision_priority: avoid false precision where thermodynamics or vendor performance is unresolved
minimize size only after protection and containment criteria pass

candidate_ranking_engine.objective: select the best compliant preliminary configuration, not simply the smallest vessel
hard_filters: all plot and transport hard constraints pass

audit_and_governance.release_rule: No result may be marked ready for multidisciplinary review while a fail-closed condition is active. No result may be marked approved for design without the organization's formal process and mechanical approval workflow.
